note: One link per fact. Hashes were written by the app's own link writer (open the app with the seed state, read location.hash); s= is explicit in every one; cal= and pn= (and t=) are the app's view keys for the calendar and the side cards; a build without them ignores them. Every link selects a region (r, c). 'action' = the month scripts/check_facts.py waits for after pressing Play.

links.label: Open on the map and press Play
links.hint: Press Play: until December 2011 only MODIS points are drawn; from January 2012 VIIRS points appear and the map fills up.
links.panels: wide: Details (MODIS / VIIRS observed counts change at 2012) + calendar (dark cells start in 2012), layer card hidden; phone/tablet: Timeline tab (calendar)

links.label: Open on the map and press Play
links.hint: Press Play: the calendar shows the dark El Niño years for Indonesia; the map fills with fires from August to October 2015 and is quiet in 2016.
links.panels: wide: Details of Indonesia + calendar (dark El Nino years), layer card hidden; phone/tablet: Timeline tab (calendar)

links.label: Open on the map and press Play
links.hint: Press Play: fires appear on the mainland in February to April, then in Indonesia from August.
links.panels: wide and phone: both side cards hidden so the wide view is not covered, calendar open (the seasonal stripes)

links.label: Open on the map and press Play
links.hint: Press Play: night-time MODIS (orange) and VIIRS (red) points in Central Kalimantan build up to the September peak; VIIRS adds many small points.
links.panels: wide: Layers card (MODIS vs VIIRS rows, Night boxes), Details and calendar hidden; phone/tablet: Timeline tab (Play lives only in that tab; with the Layers tab open Play is not on screen, so t=timeline is set and the visitor taps the Layers tab to see the rows)
